route_title: Contracted-Bound 16-Layer Stack Around Top-3 Median Thicknesses
compilation_rationale: Compiles a fixed 16-layer HfO2/SiO2 Bragg design on fused silica under normal air incidence. Thicknesses initialize near quarter-wave values and are confined to ±15% bounds. Dual-band transmission and reflection goals are scored independently across 300–450 nm and 1000–1700 nm bands using coherent TMM and L-BFGS gradient optimization. Relative tolerance analysis evaluates manufacturing robustness without altering the optical model.
